title: Three-halves influence bound
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ have Fourier degree at most $k$ and variance at most $1$ under the uniform measure. Suppose $\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]\le\varepsilon$ for every coordinate $i$, where $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$. Then $\sum_{i=1}^n\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]^{3/2}\le k\sqrt{\varepsilon}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
each coordinate influence is at most the real number $\varepsilon$
